title: Grateful Dead Live at West Palm Beach Civic Center on 1982-09-11

ai_review.summary: Excellent Seamons matrix capture of an incendiary 1982 performance with standout renditions of Scarlet Fire, Terrapin Station, Dupree's Diamond Blues and Stella Blue.
ai_review.review: The recording is a superb Seamons matrix mix that balances the crisp soundboard clarity with just enough audience ambience for an immersive listening experience. The show itself is hailed as one of the best of 1982, delivering high‑energy performances of fan favorites that are well played throughout.

ai_rating.rationale: All five reviews praise both the musical performance and the audio quality; multiple reviewers call it a top‑5 1982 show with an excellent matrix source, justifying a high rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp soundboard foundation blended with audience ambience; reviewers describe the sound as rich, clear and perfectly balanced, with no reported drop‑outs or muddiness.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A well‑balanced set that flows smoothly through personal favorites, maintaining high momentum from start to finish.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Vocals and guitar praised as excellent on the soundboard portion of the mix.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent's keyboards highlighted for standing out in the mix.
